response.query: How will recurrent or multiple seeded events per team be handled—first-event only, gap-time models, or recurrent-event models—and what is the per-protocol vs ITT definition?
response.answer: Recurrent or multiple seeded events per team will be handled using recurrent-event models. Per-protocol and ITT definitions will apply as per standard clinical trial protocols.
